UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores player progression, career word blitz stats, campaign stage, paper coins, and unlocked origami tile skins.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

bestWord.description: Highest-scoring word played by the user.

paperCoins.description: In-game currency earned from word plays and combos for unlocking cosmetic tile skins.

equippedTileSkin.description: Currently equipped cosmetic tile skin ID.

unlockedSkins.description: List of unlocked cosmetic tile skin IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SavedMatch.title: SavedMatch
SavedMatch.description: Represents an active or completed Origami: Word Blitz board game match (Campaign AI, Pass-and-Play, or Daily Blitz).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the match owner.

opponentName.description: Name of the AI master or pass-and-play challenger.

maxCombo.description: Highest combo multiplier reached during the match.

bestPlayedWord.description: Best word played during the match.

boardSnapshot.description: Compact 225-character serialized representation of the 15x15 board tiles.

rackSnapshot.description: Serialized representation of the player's 7-tile rack.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the match was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the match was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Player profile document scoped by userId.

/users/{userId}/matches/{matchId}.description: Active and completed matches scoped under the player's profile.
